blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — A 19-year-old man was arrested after allegedly selling marijuana to an undercover police officer during a buy-bust operation in San Nicolas, Ilocos Norte, on Sunday, Oct. 18. The suspect was arrested in Barangay 3, San Ildefonso, during a joint anti-illegal drug operation led by the San Nicolas Municipal Police Station. Police said the suspect allegedly sold a sachet of suspected marijuana to an officer posing as a buyer. Authorities seized 20.28 grams of suspected marijuana worth P2,433.60.
